_comment: Golden evaluation set for RAG pipeline. Each entry has: id, query, expected_facts (claims the answer MUST contain), expected_chunks_text (substrings that should appear in accepted_chunks), category, difficulty. expected_chunk_ids are doc_id:chunk_index pairs — leave empty to rely on text-substring matching only.
description: Comprehensive evaluation set covering factual, analytical, procedural, and multi-hop query categories across the 'Attention Is All You Need' corpus.

cases.query: What BLEU score did the Transformer achieve on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task?
expected_facts: The Transformer (big) achieved 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German
This improved over existing best results including ensembles by over 2 BLEU

cases.query: How many attention heads does the Transformer base model use?
expected_facts: The Transformer base model uses 8 parallel attention heads

cases.query: What is the dimensionality of the model (dmodel) in the Transformer base model?
expected_facts: The Transformer base model has dmodel = 512

cases.query: What optimizer was used to train the Transformer?
expected_facts: The Adam optimizer was used to train the Transformer

cases.query: What types of regularization were used during Transformer training?
expected_facts: Dropout was applied during Transformer training
Label smoothing was used as a regularization technique

cases.query: How does the Transformer's positional encoding work?
expected_facts: Positional encodings use sine and cosine functions of different frequencies
The positional encoding has the same dimension dmodel as the embeddings

cases.query: What is Scaled Dot-Product Attention and how is it computed?
expected_facts: Scaled Dot-Product Attention computes attention using queries, keys, and values
The dot products are scaled by 1/sqrt(dk)

cases.query: How long did it take to train the Transformer big model?
expected_facts: The Transformer big model was trained for 3.5 days

cases.query: What BLEU score did the Transformer achieve on the English-to-French translation task?
expected_facts: The Transformer achieved 41.0 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-French

cases.query: What is Multi-Head Attention and why is it used instead of single-head attention?
expected_facts: Multi-head attention allows the model to attend to information from different representation subspaces
It linearly projects queries, keys, and values h times with different learned projections

cases.query: How does the Transformer compare to recurrent models in terms of computational complexity?
expected_facts: Self-attention layers connect all positions with a constant number of sequential operations
A self-attention layer is faster than a recurrent layer when the sequence length is smaller than the representation dimensionality

cases.query: What is the encoder structure in the Transformer?
expected_facts: The encoder is a stack of N = 6 identical layers
Each encoder layer has two sub-layers: multi-head self-attention and a feed-forward network

cases.query: What training data was used for the English-German translation task?
expected_facts: The WMT 2014 English-German dataset consists of about 4.5 million sentence pairs

cases.query: What is the feed-forward network structure in the Transformer?
expected_facts: The feed-forward network consists of two linear transformations with a ReLU activation in between
The inner layer has dimensionality dff = 2048

cases.query: How did the Transformer perform on English constituency parsing?
expected_facts: The Transformer generalized well to English constituency parsing even with limited task-specific tuning

cases.query: Why does dot-product attention use a scaling factor?
expected_facts: Without scaling, for large values of dk the dot products grow large pushing the softmax into regions with extremely small gradients

cases.query: What are the three ways multi-head attention is used in the Transformer?
expected_facts: Multi-head attention is used in encoder-decoder attention layers
Multi-head attention is used in encoder self-attention layers
Multi-head attention is used in masked decoder self-attention layers

cases.query: Summarize the main contribution of the Attention Is All You Need paper
expected_facts: The Transformer is the first sequence transduction model based entirely on attention
It replaces the recurrent layers traditionally used in encoder-decoder architectures with multi-headed self-attention

cases.query: What warmup schedule was used for the learning rate during Transformer training?
expected_facts: The learning rate increased linearly during the warmup period then decreased proportionally to the inverse square root of the step number

cases.query: What dropout rate was used in the Transformer base model?
expected_facts: The Transformer base model uses a dropout rate of 0.1
